purpose: Fourteenth-pass official and first-party verification for six existing Batch-51 rows while the same V53 task remains pickup-timeout claimable. No second task, runner, checkpoint advancement, exact-parcel promotion or parcel-value publication is performed.

method.official_source_policy: Only primary auction records, current first-party operator pages, NHS or ICB records, Companies House records and local-authority licensing or planning records are promoted. Search snippets, directories and inferred lease transfers are not promoted.
method.current_status_policy: An active company, current menu, practice-list entry or pending licence application does not by itself prove legal completion, an executed lease, a granted licence or exact parcel geometry.
method.parcel_binding_policy: NO_DATA_NOT_INFERRED until exact title or canonical geometry is read.
